name: safectx
description: Create a sanitized local copy before an AI reads sensitive work files.

interface.shortDescription: Make a local AI-safe copy before sharing.
interface.longDescription: SafeContext creates deterministic sanitized copies under .ai-safe before an agent reads supported work files. Originals stay untouched, reports show only categories and counts, and private values remain on the device.
defaultPrompt: Make an AI-safe copy of these files before reading them.
Scan this workspace for secrets and create sanitized copies.
Replace this client name locally, then read only the safe copy.
